rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for HEALTH ACTORS
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेजको प्रयोग सुरु गर्न संक्षिप्त मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: A brief guide to starting to use the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for health sector stakeholders
rows.note: Proposed recurring terms: Health actors and guide. MHPSS is retained as supplied.

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for HEALTH ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका लागि न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Minimum Service Package (MSP) for mental health and psychosocial support?
rows.note: The composite MHPSS wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमूहको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of populations affected by emergencies.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य पीडा कम गर्न तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याण सुधार गर्न योगदान पुर्‍याउनु हो।
rows.bt: The aim of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Mental-health wording is reused from the supplied cited candidates; psychosocial well-being follows T005. These remain unreviewed candidates.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is necessary and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.
rows.note: Guide is a recurring term without a frozen glossary entry; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Health actors?
rows.ne: यो स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to health sector stakeholders?
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalent for Health actors.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: Mental health is an integral part of health.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य समग्र स्वास्थ्यको अभिन्न अङ्ग हो।
rows.bt: Mental health is an integral part of overall health.
rows.note: The mental-health wording is reused from supplied cited candidates; no new clinical condition or intervention terminology is introduced.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: Mental Health and physical health are strongly interconnected, with each influencing the other.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र शारीरिक स्वास्थ्य एकअर्कासँग गहिरो रूपमा अन्तरसम्बन्धित छन् र प्रत्येकले अर्कोलाई प्रभाव पार्छ।
rows.bt: Mental health and physical health are deeply interconnected with each other, and each affects the other.
rows.note: The draft retains the strong interconnection and reciprocal influence between mental and physical health.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities Health actors can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people accessing health services.
rows.ne: MSP ले स्वास्थ्य सेवा लिइरहेका व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले कार्यान्वयन गर्न र सहयोग पुर्‍याउन सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities that health sector stakeholders can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people receiving health services.
rows.note: Uses the proposed equivalent for Health actors. Mental-health and psychosocial well-being wording is reused from supplied unreviewed candidates.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.ne: मैले MSP मा स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्न सक्छु?
rows.bt: How can I find health-related content in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा चिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्। ती चिह्नहरूले सामान्यतया कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारी क्षेत्र (AoRs) उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (रङ्गीन चिह्नहरू) वा त्यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (गाढा नीलो चिह्नहरू) भन्ने देखाउँछन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity has symbols. These symbols show which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally in a suitable position to carry out that activity (coloured symbols) or to contribute to it (dark blue symbols).1
rows.note: Icons is a recurring term without a frozen glossary entry; a proposal is listed separately. AoRs and footnote marker 1 are retained.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: The blue Health icon indicates that Health actors are typically well-placed to deliver an activity.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यको नीलो चिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The blue health symbol indicates that health sector stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to carry out an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalents for Health actors and icons.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue Health icon indicates that Health actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यको गाढा नीलो चिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue health symbol indicates that health sector stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalents for Health actors and icons.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.10, Provide mental health care as part of general health services, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा उदाहरणका रूपमा गतिविधि 3.10, ‘सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने’, देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.10, ‘Provide mental health services as part of general health services’, as an example.
rows.note: The activity label is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T107 candidate.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icon shows that Health actors are typically well-placed to deliver this activity, while the dark blue icons show that Child Protection and Nutrition actors are typically well-placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन चिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ भने गाढा नीलो चिह्नहरूले बाल संरक्षण र पोषण क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The coloured symbol shows that health sector stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to carry out this activity, while the dark blue symbols show that child protection and nutrition sector stakeholders are generally in a suitable position to contribute to it.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring equivalents for Health actors and icons; delivery and contribution remain distinct.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, Child Protection actors can contribute by establishing referral pathways and links to general health services, and supporting children with mental, neurological, or substance use conditions to access such services.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, बाल संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाहरूसँगका सम्पर्कहरू स्थापना गरेर तथा मानसिक, स्नायुसम्बन्धी वा पदार्थ सेवनसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरू भएका बालबालिकालाई त्यस्ता सेवामा पहुँच प्राप्त गर्न सहयोग गरेर योगदान दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, actors working in the child protection sector can contribute by establishing service referral pathways and links with general health services and by helping children with mental, neurological or substance use-related conditions gain access to such services.
rows.note: The draft retains Child Protection actors, children as the population, the three alternative condition categories and the possibility expressed by can contribute.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: Here the colourful icons show that Protection, Child Protection, Gender-Based Violence (GBV), and Mine Action actors are typically well placed to deliver activity 3.13, Provide MHPSS through case management services.
rows.ne: यहाँ रङ्गीन चिह्नहरूले संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) र बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया गतिविधि 3.13, ‘केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने’, सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Here the coloured symbols show that stakeholders in protection, child protection, gender-based violence (GBV) and landmine-related work are generally in a suitable position to carry out activity 3.13, ‘Provide MHPSS through case management services’.
rows.note: Safety draft; review pending. The activity label follows the cited unreviewed T110 candidate. Uses the proposed equivalent for icons.

rows.section: How do I find Health content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icon shows that Health actors are typically well placed to contribute to it, for example, by establishing referral pathways and links to general health services.
rows.ne: गाढा नीलो चिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ; उदाहरणका लागि, उनीहरूले सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवासँगका सम्पर्क सम्बन्धहरू स्थापना गरेर योगदान गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: The dark blue mark indicates that the relevant parties in the health sector are generally in a suitable position to contribute to this; for example, they can contribute by establishing service referral pathways and links with general health services.
rows.note: Safety draft; review pending. Referral pathways follows T063 and does not imply automatic transfer. Uses the proposed equivalents for Health actors and icons. The source specifies establishing both referral pathways and links to general health services; the Nepali and back-translation instead describe maintaining the links. Revised to retain establishing for both.

rows.bt: Which MSP activities are most relevant to health sector stakeholders?

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: MSP activities are organized into four sections.
rows.ne: MSP गतिविधिहरूलाई चार खण्डमा व्यवस्थित गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: MSP activities are organized into four sections.
rows.note: The source spells out four; no digit has been substituted or changed.

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to Health actors?
rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Proposed recurring coordination terminology is listed separately; the frozen glossary is unchanged.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups in all sectors and AoRs, and cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 र 1.2 सबै क्षेत्र र AoRs का समन्वय समूह तथा विभिन्न क्षेत्र समेट्ने MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूहका लागि विशेष रूपमा सान्दर्भिक छन्।
rows.bt: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant to coordination groups of all sectors and AoRs and to MHPSS technical working groups covering various sectors.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: They promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिले प्रभावकारी अन्तरनिकाय तथा अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय र लेखाजोखालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्।
rows.bt: These activities promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring coordination terminology listed separately.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Ensuring mutual representation at MHPSS and Health coordination meetings. Establishing joint referral pathways between health services and the full range of MHPSS activities and services.
rows.ne: MHPSS र स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी समन्वय बैठकहरूमा एकअर्काको प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित गर्ने। स्वास्थ्य सेवा र MHPSS का सम्पूर्ण गतिविधि तथा सेवाबीच संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू स्थापना गर्ने।
rows.bt: Ensure each other's representation in MHPSS and health-related coordination meetings. Establish joint service referral pathways between health services and all MHPSS activities and services.
rows.note: General service-coordination and referral guidance drafted for review; safety review remains pending.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Including MHPSS in health assessments.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी लेखाजोखामा MHPSS समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Include MHPSS in health-related assessments.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अङ्गहरू
rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्ने सबै संस्थाले खण्ड 2 का गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ; यी गतिविधि कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणालीको कार्यान्वयन, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह तथा MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्नेसम्बन्धी छन्।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for all organizations conducting MHPSS activities to implement the activities in Section 2; these activities relate to programme design, implementation of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, care for staff and volunteers, and support for MHPSS competencies.
rows.note: Programme-management wording draws on the supplied activity-list candidates for 2.1–2.4. The back-translation strengthens 'should' to 'must'. The Nepali also adds 'their', restricting whose MHPSS competencies are supported, whereas the source leaves this unspecified.

rows.section: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.en: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.ne: खण्ड 3 र 4: MHPSS कार्यक्रमका गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: Sections 3 and 4: MHPSS programme activities

rows.section: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.en: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्ष सामान्यतया सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहने कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू निम्न छन्:
rows.bt: The programmatic activities that actors working in the health sector are generally well placed to conduct are as follows:
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering for Health actors listed separately.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Orienting health actors on MHPSS and advocating for the integration of MHPSS into health in emergencies programming. Advocating for the provision of health services in ways that are inclusive, person-centered, promote dignity, enhance social support, and respect human rights. Advocating to address the social determinants of mental health, including risk and protective factors. Engaging in advocacy, promotion and prevention together with other sectors and actors to build awareness of mental health, and to end stigma and discrimination.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रममा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्न पैरवी गर्ने। स्वास्थ्य सेवा समावेशी र व्यक्तिकेन्द्रित हुने, मर्यादा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने, सामाजिक सहयोग बढाउने तथा मानव अधिकारको सम्मान गर्ने तरिकाले प्रदान गर्न पैरवी गर्ने। जोखिम तथा संरक्षणकारी कारकसहित मानसिक स्वास्थ्यका सामाजिक निर्धारकलाई सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने। मानसिक स्वास्थ्यबारे सचेतना बढाउन तथा कलङ्क र भेदभाव अन्त्य गर्न अन्य क्षेत्र र पक्षसँग मिलेर पैरवी, प्रवर्द्धन र रोकथामका कार्यमा संलग्न हुने।
rows.bt: Orient actors working in the health sector on MHPSS and advocate for integrating MHPSS into health-related programmes in emergencies. Advocate for health services to be provided in ways that are inclusive and person-centred, promote dignity, increase social support, and respect human rights. Advocate for addressing the social determinants of mental health, including risk and protective factors. Engage in advocacy, promotion and prevention work together with other sectors and actors to increase awareness about mental health and end stigma and discrimination.
rows.note: Ordinary advocacy and public-health programme content is translated rather than protected. Uses the separately proposed rendering for Health actors; mental-health wording reuses wording present in the supplied unreviewed candidates.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Exact supplied unreviewed activity candidate retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Orienting health workers on basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient health workers in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: The psychosocial-support skills phrase is reused exactly from the cited unreviewed candidate T099; it is not newly coined or validated.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Exact supplied unreviewed activity candidate retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Identifying and incorporating key MHPSS messages into health activities and informational materials.
rows.ne: MHPSS का मुख्य सन्देशहरू पहिचान गरी स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सूचनामूलक सामग्रीमा समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Identify key MHPSS messages and include them in health-related activities and informational materials.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: The frozen activity label renders pre-existing as already operating, imposing an operating-status restriction that the source does not contain. bt-divergence: Frozen T101 renders pre-existing as already operating, restricting the activity scope to operating activities although the source does not impose that condition. Frozen wording retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Supporting pre-existing community initiatives and facilitating new group-based community initiatives that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of community members.
rows.ne: पहिलेदेखि अस्तित्वमा रहेका सामुदायिक पहललाई सहयोग गर्ने र समुदायका सदस्यको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने समूहमा आधारित नयाँ सामुदायिक पहललाई सहजीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support pre-existing community initiatives and facilitate new group-based community initiatives that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of community members.
rows.note: The mental-health and psychosocial-well-being phrase is reused from the supplied unreviewed candidates T100 and T104. The Nepali attaches the mental-health and psychosocial-well-being purpose to the pre-existing initiatives, leaving the new initiatives unqualified; the source attaches it to the new group-based initiatives. 'Already ongoing' also narrows 'pre-existing'.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers
rows.ne: 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Integrating programs into health services that promote the mental health and well-being of caregivers of young children and of those expecting children, as well as their ability to provide responsive care and early learning opportunities for the children in their care. Provide opportunities for young children to play and learn at health facilities.
rows.ne: साना बालबालिकाका हेरचाहकर्ता र सन्तानको प्रतीक्षामा रहेका व्यक्तिको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने तथा आफ्नो हेरचाहमा रहेका बालबालिकालाई उनीहरूका आवश्यकता र सङ्केतअनुसार गरिने स्याहार र प्रारम्भिक सिकाइका अवसर प्रदान गर्ने ती व्यक्तिको क्षमता प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने कार्यक्रम स्वास्थ्य सेवामा एकीकृत गर्ने। स्वास्थ्य संस्थामा साना बालबालिकालाई खेल्ने र सिक्ने अवसर प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Integrate into health services programmes that promote the mental health and well-being of caregivers of young children and people expecting a child, and promote those people's capacity to provide children in their care with care according to their needs and signals and with early learning opportunities. Provide young children with opportunities to play and learn in health facilities.
rows.note: Responsive-care wording follows T083 with contextual pronouns; its full glossary phrase is not reproduced literally. Mental-health wording reuses the supplied unreviewed candidates. No psychosocial qualifier has been added to the source's broader well-being wording.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Exact supplied unreviewed activity candidate retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Integrating programs into health services that promote positive caregiving skills and support caregivers to look after their own physical and mental health needs.
rows.ne: सकारात्मक हेरचाहका सीप प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र हेरचाहकर्तालाई आफ्नै शारीरिक तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको ख्याल राख्न सहयोग गर्ने कार्यक्रम स्वास्थ्य सेवामा एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Integrate into health services programmes that promote positive caregiving skills and support caregivers in attending to their own physical and mental health needs.
rows.note: This is general programme-integration content, not a clinical procedure. Mental-health wording reuses wording present in the supplied unreviewed candidates.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.10 Provide mental health services as a component of general health services.
rows.note: Exact supplied unreviewed activity candidate retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Integrating mental health care into general health care.
rows.ne: सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवामा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Integrate mental health services into general health services.
rows.note: The care terminology is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate T107; no new clinical term is introduced.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 2 These examples should not be considered exhaustive.
rows.ne: 2 यी उदाहरणलाई सम्पूर्ण सूचीका रूपमा लिनु उचित हुँदैन।
rows.bt: 2 It is not appropriate to take these examples as a complete list.
rows.note: The back-translation strengthens 'should not' to 'must not'. The revision preserves the negative recommendation without an absolute prohibition.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: For a more comprehensive list of actions, see the checklists under each MSP activity.
rows.ne: कार्यहरूको अझ व्यापक सूचीका लागि प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिअन्तर्गतका जाँचसूची हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For a more comprehensive list of tasks, see the checklists under each MSP activity.
rows.note: 'More detailed' does not preserve 'more comprehensive': the source refers to broader coverage of actions, not greater detail.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner.
rows.note: The frozen activity and population wording denotes affected people, which can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifies survivors who directly experienced and survived the violence. bt-divergence: Frozen T108 and its population wording refer to people affected by the violence, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors who directly experienced and survived it. Frozen wording retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Building the capacity of health care providers on aspects of MHPSS specific to sexual violence and IPV (e.g. providing first-line support to survivors, managing disclosure, facilitating links and referrals to additional services).
rows.ne: यौन हिंसा र IPV सँग सम्बन्धित MHPSS का विशिष्ट पक्षहरूमा स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदायकहरूको क्षमता विकास गर्ने (उदाहरणका लागि, प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई प्रारम्भिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने, हिंसाबारे गरिएको खुलासालाई सुरक्षित रूपमा सम्हाल्ने, थप सेवाहरूसँगको सम्पर्क र सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यलाई सहज बनाउने)।
rows.bt: Develop the capacity of health service providers in specific aspects of MHPSS related to sexual violence and IPV (for example, providing initial support to affected persons, safely handling disclosures about violence, facilitating links with additional services and referral to relevant services).
rows.note: The frozen population label denotes affected people rather than specifically direct survivors; the frozen disclosure wording also explicitly adds safe handling, which the source does not state separately. bt-divergence: Frozen T317 denotes affected persons rather than specifically survivors, potentially broadening the population to indirectly affected people. Frozen T077 explicitly adds safe handling to managing disclosure. Both frozen forms retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions.
rows.note: Exact supplied unreviewed activity candidate retained; no new clinical terminology is introduced.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Delivering scalable psychological interventions to address impairment due to psychological distress and mental health conditions as part of health services.
rows.ne: मानसिक व्यथा र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूका कारण क्षमतामा आएको ह्रासलाई सम्बोधन गर्न स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा विस्तार गर्न सकिने मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेप प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide psychological interventions that can be expanded as part of health services to address the decline in capacity caused by mental distress and mental health-related conditions.
rows.note: No frozen equivalent for impairment is supplied; it is drafted as reduced capacity, while psychological interventions remain a general category rather than a named therapy.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for people in mental hospitals and other institutions
rows.note: Exact supplied T111 activity candidate retained; existing clinical wording is unreviewed.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Assessing and addressing the basic physical, protection, and mental health care needs among people in institutions and promoting and protecting their rights.
rows.ne: संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूका आधारभूत शारीरिक आवश्यकता, संरक्षणसम्बन्धी आवश्यकता र मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवासम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्ने र तिनलाई सम्बोधन गर्ने तथा उनीहरूका अधिकारको प्रवर्द्धन र संरक्षण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Assess and address the basic physical needs, protection-related needs and mental health service-related needs of people in institutions, and promote and protect their rights.
rows.note: Preserve the source clinical meaning, population, intervention scope and referral conditions; human translation required. Reclassified as general safety guidance. The existing phrase मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा is reused from the supplied T107 activity candidate, not newly coined. Language and relevant domain review remain pending.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS considerations and support into clinical case management for infectious diseases
rows.ne: 4.1 सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र सहयोग एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS-related considerations and support into the clinical case management of communicable diseases.
rows.note: The frozen activity label uses wording for communicable diseases, whereas the source specifies infectious diseases, which also include infections that are not communicable. bt-divergence: Frozen T112 uses सरुवा रोग, denoting communicable diseases, whereas infectious diseases also include infections that are not communicable. Frozen wording retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Integrating MHPSS into clinical case management for infectious diseases, for example by providing MHPSS to persons with infectious diseases and their family members and by including MHPSS considerations to reduce psychological distress for those who are hospitalized.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, सरुवा रोग भएका व्यक्तिहरू र उनीहरूका परिवारका सदस्यहरूलाई MHPSS प्रदान गरेर तथा अस्पतालमा भर्ना भएका व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक व्यथा कम गर्न MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्षहरू समेटेर सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: For example, integrate MHPSS into the clinical case management of communicable diseases by providing MHPSS to persons with communicable diseases and their family members and by incorporating MHPSS-related considerations to reduce the mental distress of persons admitted to hospital.
rows.note: The frozen disease wording denotes communicable diseases rather than the full infectious-disease category; the draft otherwise retains family members and the distress-reduction purpose for hospitalized people. bt-divergence: Frozen T242 denotes communicable diseases rather than the broader infectious-disease category, narrowing both the clinical case-management scope and the population receiving MHPSS. Frozen wording retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: 4.2 स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to people deprived of liberty
rows.note: Exact supplied T113 activity candidate retained; existing clinical wording is unreviewed.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Providing access to mental health and psychosocial support for those deprived of their liberty and advocating for MHPSS considerations (e.g. maintaining family and social connections; ensuring availability of private spaces for provision of confidential mental health and psychosocial support).
rows.ne: स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगमा पहुँच उपलब्ध गराउने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्षका लागि पैरवी गर्ने (जस्तै, पारिवारिक तथा सामाजिक सम्बन्ध कायम राख्ने; गोपनीय रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्न निजी स्थानहरूको उपलब्धता सुनिश्चित गर्ने)।
rows.bt: Provide people deprived of liberty with access to mental health and psychosocial support and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations (for example, maintaining family and social relationships; ensuring the availability of private spaces to provide mental health and psychosocial support confidentially).
rows.note: General safety guidance drafted for review, not a verbatim safeguarding declaration. T001 is reused as an existing unreviewed clinical candidate.
